XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Running engine shutdown with hard restart, immobilizer light and oil level warning light on
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P0091 | P0092 | P0094 | P0190 | REGULATOR | PRESSURE | FUEL | DIESEL | DIESEL FUEL | SWITCHES OFF | STOPS | RUN | STARTS | RUNS | FAILURE | START-UP | SWITCHES OFF | IMMEDIATELY |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine fuel supply

  • Device: Fuel pressure regulator

  • Fault: Occasional engine stalling whilst driving, failed starts and normal starts followed by sudden engine stalling.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • P0091 (Fuel pressure regulator 1 – Low value)
  • P0092 (Fuel pressure regulator 1 – High value)
  • P0094 (Fuel leak, fuel system – Minor)
  • P0190 (Fuel line pressure sensor – Generic fault)
  • Cause: Faulty fuel pressure regulator

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the fuel pressure regulator and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The regulator is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side, between the engine and the radiator, at the bottom, connected to the high-pressure fuel pump.
    It is not necessary to remove the high-pressure fuel pump from the vehicle to access it.
